question.problem:
$$
{f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,8)=\{\begin{aligned}0.45, & y=4 \\ 0.55, & y=6 \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Suppose $X$ and $Y$ are discrete random variables. Find the conditional variance $\text{Var}[Y\,|\,X=8]$ given that the conditional probability mass function ${f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,8)$ is shown above and the corresponding conditional expected value is ${\mu }_{Y|8}=5.1.$
question.worked_solution:
Recall that the conditional variance of $Y$ given $X=x$ is defined by

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[Y\,|\,X=x] & =\text{E}[(Y-{\mu }_{Y|x})^{2}\,|\,X=x] \\  & =\text{E}[{Y}^{2}\,|\,X=x]-{\mu }_{Y|x}^{2} \\  & =[{\sum }_{y}{y}^{2}\,{f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,x)]-{\mu }_{Y|x}^{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[Y\,|\,X=8] & =[{\sum }_{y}{y}^{2}\,{f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,8)]-{\mu }_{Y|8}^{2} \\  & =[(4)^{2}\cdot 0.45+(6)^{2}\cdot 0.55]-(5.1)^{2} \\  & =7.2+19.8-26.01 \\  & =0.99.\end{aligned}
$$
